title: 007 人血尸血008 妖尸杨鲤
content_zh:
：管明晦利用杨鲤的飞剑把自己的十根指甲全部斩断。
看那小子满脸激动，连喷真气催动飞剑，仿佛下一刻就能将自己斩杀当场，不禁觉得好笑。
他挥手之间，凭空涌出大量黑眚煞气，中央的主幡出现，一只百年山魈出现，怒吼着将杨鲤的飞剑挡住。
杨鲤面前也出现两杆玄阴幡，上面的主神是一只马熊，一条吹蚺，双双向杨鲤攻去，杨鲤急忙要把飞剑召回去护身，却被主幡绊住。
招不回飞剑，杨鲤大吃一惊，急忙掐诀施展隐身法，凭空隐身遁走。
蜀山世界里面，会隐身法的不少，但道行有深浅，法力有高低。
杨鲤本身法力就不怎么强，崔海客的旁门法术也不怎么高明，玄阴聚兽幡上的兽魂早将他锁定。
两团黑气前后包抄，将他的去路截住。
管明晦伸出右手向前虚抓，事前埋伏下的两面玄阴网同时出现。
玄阴网是他用黑眚丝织成的，如蛛网一般，上面一张，往下罩落，下面一张，网上兜起。
他用的是二转的黑眚丝，杨鲤如果飞剑还在身边，施展身剑合一，能将这网钻破，逃出生天，可此时飞剑被主幡绊住，无路可逃，被两张网合成一张，罩头兜脚网在里面。
没费什么力气就将这小子拿下，管明晦心里却没有半点放松。
他还是担心会不会惊动华瑶崧。
将幡重新归于原位，仍然埋伏地下，管明晦把杨鲤弄到面前。
黑眚丝是用黑眚和煞气炼成，最能损人精气，普通人触碰到会肢体麻痹，再无挣扎的余地，杨鲤被网成一团，肌肤贴着网丝的地方难受至极，一股股玄阴煞气直往肉里面钻，他拼命运功相抗，脸都涨红了。
管明晦厉声喝问：“你是什么人？为什么会到这里来？”
“男子汉大丈夫，行不更名坐不改姓，我乃南海杨鲤是也！”
“你是杨鲤？”
管明晦大感意外，“你不是峨眉派弟子？你师父是不是在南海聚萍岛修真，叫做凌虚子崔海客？”
“正是！”

不是峨眉弟子，这让管明晦悄悄松了口气，那就代表还没到正传开始时候，自己还有时间继续修炼。
不过杨鲤这时候应该在紫云宫吧，正传开始前五十年杨鲤都应该在紫云宫。
他出现在这里……难道陆蓉波还没有被捉去紫云宫？
“我问你，陆蓉波你可认得？她现在怎么样了？”
这下轮到杨鲤感到意外了：“你认识陆师姐？她跟陆师伯在玄霜洞修真……不对，你跟陆师姐到底是什么关系？”
陆蓉波还跟陆敏在玄霜洞！
要是这样的话，距离正传开始，没有一百年，也得有八十年！
“你确定陆敏还活着？他还在玄霜洞？跟陆蓉波在一起？”
他再问，杨鲤却不说话了，用怀疑的目光看着他。
管明晦沉声说：“我问你话，你敢不回答？”
杨鲤却很硬气：“既然落到你的手里，你要杀就杀，要刮就刮，略微皱一下眉头，就不是好汉！”
“小东西，还跟我装好汉！”
管明晦看着对方脸上稚气未脱，却一副要英勇就义的表情感到好笑，“我问你，我与你有什么仇什么怨？你先斩了我用来炼法的灵木，又找到这里，见面就放飞剑要杀我？”
“残害生灵，修炼邪法的果然是你！”
这话管明晦不爱听：“我怎么就残害生灵了？我杀几个熊，宰几条蛇，用来滋补身体，修炼法术，怎么就不行了？那我只有这种法术，邪不邪正不正的，你有什么正法教给我，能把我身体养好，我就不杀它们。”
“呸！
妖尸！
天下正道，人人见而诛之！”
content_en:
: Guan Minghui used Yang Li's flying sword to cut off all ten of his nails.
I couldn't help but find it funny to see the kid's face full of excitement, and he spurted his Qi to activate the flying sword, as if he could behead him on the spot in the next moment.
As he waved his hand, a large amount of black evil energy surged out of thin air. The main flag in the center appeared, and a century-old mandrill appeared, roaring and blocking Yang Li's flying sword.
Two Xuanyin flags also appeared in front of Yang Li. The main gods on them were a horse bear and an anaconda. They both attacked Yang Li. Yang Li hurriedly recalled the flying sword to protect himself, but was tripped by the main flags.
Yang Li was shocked when he couldn't move the flying sword back. He hurriedly used the invisibility method and escaped out of thin air.
In the Shushan world, there are many people who know the invisibility method, but there are different levels of Taoism and different levels of magic power.
Yang Li's own magic power is not very strong, and Cui Haike's side magic is not very good either. The beast soul on the Xuanyin Beast Gathering Flag has already locked him.
Two groups of black energy surrounded him front and back, blocking his path.
Guan Minghui stretched out his right hand to make a false grab, and the two mysterious nets that had been ambush appeared at the same time.
The Xuanyin Net was woven by him with black silk, like a spider web, with the upper one covering it downwards and the lower one being lifted up by the web.
He used the second-turn black silk. If Yang Li was still with Feijian, he could use his body and sword to merge into one, and he could break through the net and escape. However, at this time, Feijian was caught by the main flag and had no way to escape. The two nets merged into one, with the hood, head and foot nets inside.
He took down this kid without much effort, but Guan Minghui didn't feel relaxed at all.
He was still worried about whether he would alarm Hua Yaosong.
Returning the banner to its original position, still lying in ambush, Guan Minghui brought Yang Li in front of him.
Black Wisdom Silk is made from black heat and evil energy, which is the most damaging to a person's essence. If an ordinary person touches it, his limbs will be paralyzed and there will be no room for struggle. Yang Li was bundled up in the net, and his skin was extremely uncomfortable where his skin was close to the mesh. The mysterious evil energy penetrated straight into his flesh. He tried his best to resist, and his face turned red.
Guan Minghui asked sharply: "Who are you? Why are you here?"
"A true man, I won't change my name in work or in office. I am Yang Li from the South China Sea!"
"Are you Yang Li?"
Guan Minghui was greatly surprised, "Aren't you a disciple of the Emei sect? Is your master cultivating on Juping Island in the South China Sea, and his name is Ling Xuzi Cui Haike?"
"Exactly!"
He was not a disciple of Emei. This made Guan Minghui sigh quietly, which meant that he still had time to continue practicing before the main story started.
But Yang Li should be in Ziyun Palace at this time. Yang Li should have been in Ziyun Palace fifty years before the start of the main story.
He appeared here... Could it be that Lu Rongbo hasn't been taken to Ziyun Palace yet?
"Let me ask you, do you recognize Lu Rongbo? How is she doing now?"
Now it was Yang Li's turn to be surprised: "Do you know Senior Sister Lu? She and Uncle Lu were cultivating in Xuanshuang Cave... No, what is the relationship between you and Senior Sister Lu?"
Lu Rongbo is still in Xuanshuang Cave with Lu Min!
If this is the case, it will be not a hundred years but eighty years before the main story begins!
"Are you sure Lu Min is still alive? Is he still in Xuanshuang Cave? With Lu Rongbo?"
He asked again, but Yang Li stopped talking and looked at him suspiciously.
Guan Minghui said in a deep voice, "How dare you not answer when I ask you a question?"
But Yang Li was very tough: "Now that I've fallen into your hands, you can kill me if you want, and scratch me if you want. If you frown even slightly, you are not a good man!"
"Little thing, you still pretend to be a hero with me!"
Guan Minghui was amused when he saw that the other person's face was still childish, but he looked like he was about to die heroically. "Let me ask you, what grudge do I have with you? You first chopped off the spiritual wood that I used to practice my magic, and then found this place, and when we met, you let your sword fly to kill me?"
"You are indeed the one who harms living beings and practices evil methods!"
This is what Minghui doesn’t like to hear: "Why did I harm living creatures? I killed a few bears and slaughtered a few snakes to nourish my body and practice magic. How could I?"Not working anymore? Then I only have this kind of magic, whether it is evil or righteous, do you have any righteous method to teach me that can take care of my body, so I will not kill them. "
“Bah!
Monster corpse!
The right way in the world will be punished by everyone who sees it! "
